samples.marker_line: MIPS shell loader: fix architecture and hidden-background launch traits
evidence: Complete 187-byte POSIX script; no obfuscation.
Changes to /tmp with /var/tmp fallback; wget/curl fetch one mirai.mips payload to .b.
Makes .b executable and starts ./.b in the background; errors on chdir/chmod are suppressed.
No evidence for multiple architectures, theft, botnet commands, or propagation in this script. Hidden detached deployment supports suspicious traits; the payload family is unverified.

samples.marker_line: SNOWLIGHT ARM loader: cover XOR and anonymous execution; fix taxonomy
evidence: ARM Thumb ELF main 0x106a8; no packing or string obfuscation.
0x106b2-0x106bc: access(/tmp/log_de.log,F_OK), exit when it exists; a stop-file gate, with no analysis-specific probe.
Connects to 81.70.143.19:4567; retries a failed connection after 10 seconds.
0x1072c-0x1075e: formatted HTTP GET with a=a32, h=host, t=ws_, p=port; sends 1024 bytes.
0x1076e-0x107a2: consumes the HTTP headers; syscall(385,name,1) creates a memfd at 0x107a4-0x107ac.
0x107b8-0x107e4: recv -> XOR every byte with 0x99 -> write to memfd.
0x107f8-0x1081e: sets CWD to its own executable realpath, calls fexecve on memfd with argv[0]=[kworker/0:2].
No Mirai scanning or DDoS behavior in this loader; fetched stage was not acquired or run.

samples.marker_line: Managed surveillance hybrid: cover Defender and shadow-copy deletion
evidence: Unobfuscated managed PE; original filename metadata is tructiep90phuttv.org_chrome.exe. Family names in mutexes and collector filename do not prove family identity.
Entry MethodDef 29 invokes persistence, keylogging, input blocking, UAC bypass, security-service interference, and shadow deletion. Async helpers and thread delegates were followed to their bodies.
Methods 47,49,50,131: install WH_KEYBOARD_LL; record keys/window/timestamps; poll keys 1..255 every 50ms; flush Base64 keylogs through SendToC2.
Methods 52,146: take JPEG screenshots every 30 seconds; monitor clipboard and record changes. Method 73 copies Chromium Login Data, cookies, history and other stores.
Method 90 appends local log records then calls WebClient.UploadString to http://tructiep90phuttv.org. HTTP delivery is attempted, not confirmed.
Method 54 repeatedly copies the executing image to removable drives, hides it and writes executable AutoRun directives. Method 46 writes Run keys, startup copy and logon/30-minute tasks.
Method 79 sets the ms-settings command and empty DelegateExecute value, starts fodhelper.exe and schedules cleanup.
Method 82 Base64-encodes UTF-16 PowerShell that disables Defender monitoring and adds an exclusion, then launches a hidden encoded command. Method 66 launches vssadmin and wmic shadow deletion.

Methods 60 and 150 implement file replacement in Desktop/TestFolder; static AES key is 17 bytes and IV is 15 bytes. Key assignment throws before encryption/output/deletion; do not claim successful bulk encryption. Ransom notes, lockout, wallpaper and other hostile operations are independently present.
Fake PDF creation is document/lure content, not evidence of a PDF reader exploit. Process injection references do not prove a functioning injected payload.
